title: Confidential deal-team update
text:
Subject: Project Kingfisher – update before Thursday's board call

Team,

Quick update on Kingfisher. Orion Capital is now prepared to move to a binding offer for Tarang Foods at an enterprise value of ₹1,850 crore, subject to diligence on the Nashik plant. Tarang's FY26 revenue came in at ₹642 crore, slightly below their management case.

Deepak Rao (Orion's CFO) wants the term sheet circulated by 18 November 2026. Meera Pillai at Granite Advisors is coordinating the lender group; her direct line is +91 22 6118 4402 and she prefers email at meera.pillai@graniteadvisors.com.

Please keep this strictly within the deal team — Tarang's employees have not been told.

Arjun
Deal Lead, Orion Capital
check: Project Kingfisher is a PROJECT codename (and 'Kingfisher' is the same entity)
Orion Capital (acquirer), Tarang Foods (target, also 'Tarang'), Granite Advisors are ORGs
₹1,850 crore is DEAL_VALUE; ₹642 crore is REVENUE owned by Tarang Foods
Deepak Rao is EMPLOYED_BY Orion; Meera Pillai's phone and email belong to her ('her', 'she')
Arjun (the sender) is a separate person, deal lead at Orion
